description: Stop lying to yourself, the push / pull game is for rookies. You’re past that. #selflove #selfcare #selfimprovement
transcript: Enough is enough. Stop playing the push pull game and for yourself from the outcome. Learn to let things go. The truth will always reveal itself. It is up to us to sit back and listen. Far too often are we asking clarifying questions for an answer that we already have because we are trying to change the response.
